tip.en: HR is still 90 bpm while pace has jumped to sub-5:00 — your heart hasn't caught up yet. This gap often leads to overcooking the first kilometre; the data shows HR rockets from 90 to 130+ in the next 90 seconds.
tip.zh: 配速已冲到5分以内，心率却仍在90次——心血管系统还没跟上。接下来90秒内心率将从90骤升至130+，提示你前段出力过猛。

tip.en: Grade spikes to 12.2% here and you hold ~6:00 pace while HR jumps from 136 to 141 in 18 seconds — a controlled, efficient response compared to recent hilly runs where HR spiked to 162–169 on similar terrain. Good composure.
tip.zh: 坡度陡至12.2%，配速维持在约6分，心率18秒内仅从136升至141——相比近期跑坡时心率飙至162–169，本次明显更从容高效。

tip.en: Pace collapses to null/walk for ~20 seconds at 15.5 m altitude — the highest point of the route. HR drops from 145 to 137 during the pause. A traffic crossing or shoelace? Either way it artificially flatters your overall average pace.
tip.zh: 在海拔最高点（15.5米）附近停顿约20秒，心率从145降至137。可能是红灯或系鞋带，但这会虚报整体平均配速，需留意。

title.zh: 第二次停顿——心率在中途停滞

tip.en: Another 30-second near-standstill at km 2.5, pace showing 46:18 and 24:31. HR had been climbing through 143 and flatlines here. Notably HR then drops sharply to 134 over the next 15 points — your aerobic engine cools faster than ideal mid-run.
tip.zh: 2.5公里处再次近乎停止约30秒，配速显示46:18。心率本已升至143，停顿后15个点内迅速跌至134——有氧引擎中途冷却过快。

tip.en: From km 3.1 to 3.2 you string together paces of 4:26, 4:15, 4:36 on flat ground with HR climbing cleanly from 148 to 152 — your best effort-to-output ratio of the run. This band of HR (148–152) on flat terrain is where your fitness is currently sitting.
tip.zh: 3.1–3.2公里平路段，连续跑出4:26、4:15、4:36配速，心率平稳从148升至152——全程效率最高区间，代表你当前真实的平路节奏上限。

title.en: Late-Run HR Ceiling — 155 on Mild Grade
title.zh: 跑程后段心率触顶——仅3%坡就达155

tip.en: HR hits 155 — today's max — on only a 2–3% grade at km 5.3, while pace is a modest 6:47. With 1 km to go and HR already pegged, this reveals residual fatigue from the jet-lag recovery block (you're two days off 'Jetlagging'). Compare: on 山景城 two days ago the same HR came with 169 bpm peaks; today's ceiling is lower, suggesting cumulative load.
tip.zh: 5.3公里处仅2–3%坡度、配速6:47时，心率便触及全程最高155——距终点还有1公里就已触顶。结合两天前的倒时差跑，这反映出累积疲劳尚未完全消退。

title.en: Cardiac Drift Arrested — Flat Finish Tempo
title.zh: 心率漂移停止——平稳收尾

tip.en: HR settles from 155 back to 150 and holds there for the final 1.3 km at a consistent 5:30–5:50 pace — a tidy aerobic cooldown within the run itself. This self-regulation after the late surge is better than recent sessions where you either faded hard or stopped entirely.
tip.zh: 心率从155回落并稳定在150左右，以5:30–5:50配速平稳跑完最后1.3公里。这种冲刺后的自我调节优于近期几次跑步中出现的明显掉速或中途停顿。
